title: MixJudge: Learning a Language-Queryable Critic for Vocal Mixing
abstract: arXiv:2610.30783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixing requires not only applying processing but also assessing the resulting mix. Audio-language models can provide conversa- tional mixing advice, but existing evaluations do not separately test whether they can judge specific mixing issues. Since professional supervision for such judgments is scarce, we construct a curriculum of 11 vocal-mix issues at multiple severity levels and use it to train MixJudge, a language-queryable audio critic. MixJudge shows its ability to retrieve mixing issues, distinguish opposite issues, and order the severity of an issue. Moreover, its judgments transfer to menu selection: given a set of processing candidates, MixJudge often favors versions acoustically closer to a held-out professional version, demonstrating how explicit mixing judgment can support comparison and downstream mixing decisions.

translated_title: MixJudge：学习一种面向人声混音的语言可查询评判器
translated_abstract: 混音不仅需要应用处理手段，还需要评估混音后的结果。音频-语言模型能够提供对话式的混音建议，但现有评估并未单独测试这些模型能否判断具体的混音问题。由于此类判断的专业监督数据稀缺，我们构建了一套涵盖11种人声混音问题、包含多个严重程度级别的课程化训练体系，并用它训练了MixJudge——一个可通过语言查询的音频评判器。MixJudge展现了检索混音问题、区分相反问题以及对问题严重程度进行排序的能力。此外，其判断能力还可迁移到菜单式选择任务中：给定一组处理候选方案时，MixJudge往往更青睐在声学上更接近留出专业版本的方案，这证明了显式的混音判断能力如何能够支持比较任务和下游的混音决策。
tldr: 提出MixJudge，一个基于11种多严重程度人声混音问题课程训练的语言可查询音频评判器，能够检索和区分混音问题、评估问题严重程度，并可将其判断迁移至处理候选选择任务，支持下游混音决策。
en_tdlr: MixJudge is a language-queryable audio critic trained on a curriculum of 11 vocal-mixing issues across severity levels that can retrieve, distinguish, and rank mixing problems, with judgments that transfer to selecting processing candidates closer to held-out professional mixes.
